title: Approximate ascent drag curve from Pezent 2024 Fig.2.13(b), extended to Mach 10 by declared estimate
locator: Printed p.76 / PDF p.93, Fig.2.13(b); reference area from Table 2.18, p.77
method: Knots up to Mach 7: unchanged raster centerline digitization of the blue curve (see data/drag_curve_pezent.json for the original readout record). Knots at Mach 8 and 10: appended declared estimate, slow hypersonic decay of about 5 percent per Mach unit, consistent with the asymptotic flattening of slender-launch-vehicle Cd curves.
uncertainty: Mach 0..7: approximate figure readout (see the original record). Mach 7..10: declared estimate with no sourced data; the affected regime lies above roughly 55 km altitude where the local dynamic pressure keeps the drag contribution below about 0.5 percent of stage thrust, so the trajectory impact of this uncertainty is small.
geometry_scope: Published RasAeroII, 0-degree AoA, Falcon9-like full stack with 5.2 m fairing. Applying it to the mixed-source vehicle is an explicit model assumption.
